# SAIR Foundation

> Index to every SAIR Foundation challenge entered: the open problem each
> one states, the repository holding the method and the code, and what
> that method actually reached. Open science competitions in mathematics
> and computation, run by the Foundation for Science and AI Research.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Licence: CC BY 4.0, attribution required
Repository created: 8 September 2026

## What is in this repository

- README.md, the index itself
- assets, 4 files

This repository holds no method of its own. Each challenge keeps its own
code, its own documentation and its own account of where it stopped.

## The challenges indexed

- Andrews-Curtis Conjecture: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/SAIR-ANDREWS-CURTIS-CHALLENGE
- Lean Kernel, Stage 1: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/SAIR-LEAN-KERNEL-CHALLENGE
- Mathematics Distillation, Equational Theories: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/SAIR-MATHEMATICS-DISTILLATION-CHALLENGE
- Inverse Galois Problem, IGP24: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/SAIR-INVERSE-GALOIS-PROBLEM-IGP24
- Modular Arithmetic: https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/SAIR-MODULAR-ARITHMETIC-CHALLENGE
